prompt: Diligence question from the client: does the executed stock purchase agreement in the Meridian Grid / Corvess Analytics acquisition include an earn-out or any other contingent purchase-price consideration? Query the matter documents, identify the execution version of that agreement (an earlier superseded draft discussed an earn-out concept — the executed agreement controls), and read it in full. If the executed agreement DOES contain an earn-out or contingent consideration provision, record a matter review on legal_matters_001 with reviewer_role set exactly to 'deal_points_analyst' and outcome set exactly to 'earn_out_present', with a rationale citing the provision. If it does NOT, do not create any review; instead create a remediation on legal_matters_001 with owner_role set exactly to 'deal_team_associate', action_required set exactly to 'confirm-no-earn-out', and a short due_note asking the deal team to confirm the tracker shows no contingent consideration for this deal. Do not invent an earn-out amount from drafts or other deals.
goal: Absence trap: the executed Meridian/Corvess SPA expressly has no earn-out; the correct action is a remediation, and recording an earn-out review fails.
